whyItMatters: The official dsh-market index (11430-star marketplace, DSH built-in Discover tab, plugin_market agent tool) gates entries on npm publication.
Before 2026-11-09 the plugin was absent from all 4872 index entries because npm was unpublished; the Awesome catalog PR merge did not cover this pipeline.
Listing makes the plugin searchable and one-click installable inside DSH itself, without requiring users to add a custom index source.
knownGap: CORRECTED: metadata.keywords is empty by upstream design (scripts/lib/market-index.mjs omits format defaults to save bytes and says so in a comment). It is not a defect and not fixable from our side. The binding constraint on discovery is zero downloads and zero stars, which ranks this entry below 加载更多 on broad queries.

rankingMechanism.conclusion: Discoverability is gated by popularity signals (downloads, stars), not by search coverage or listing metadata.
